# Outputs are generated by *your* real model run

This folder contains **no empirical TabICL full-cohort results** when unzipped. The synthetic tests were run elsewhere and are NOT packaged as findings.

After `--run` and `--report`, expect `cases/manifest.json`, 544 `cases/case_*.json`, 17 tables under `tables/`, five plots under `figures/`, a `tables/summary.json` and `tables/W1_COMPLETE_REPORT.md`.

`--report` must refuse to call an incomplete run complete. Do not commit case-level outputs or private checkpoint files to public GitHub. See `../LAYOUT.md` for verification details.
